name: NorthWorks Wireless Radar
tagline: LiDAR + mmWave radar on ESP32-S3 with Android display
description: NorthWorks Wireless Radar is a hardware project that combines rotating LiDAR and mmWave radar on an ESP32-S3 and streams the result to an Android display. It is a hands-on reverse-engineering and embedded systems exercise, showing how to fuse two sensing modalities and render them in real time on a phone. For makers and security researchers, it is a practical showcase of wireless sensing and embedded-to-mobile data plumbing.
highlights: Rotating LiDAR plus mmWave radar fused on an ESP32-S3
Real-time rendering streamed to an Android display
Hands-on reverse-engineering of wireless sensing hardware
curatorNote: Fusing two sensing modalities on a single ESP32 and pushing it to a phone is a genuinely interesting embedded exercise. It sits at the intersection of hardware hacking and security research, which is a combination worth watching.
